text: TELUS Corporation is TSX/NYSE-listed with a dispersed shareholder base: per TELUS's own 2026 Information Circular, 'no one shareholder beneficially owned, directly or indirectly, or exercised control or direction over, five per cent or more of the outstanding shares' as of the 9 March 2026 Record Date. No state or state-fund owner is identified.
